messages:
emily_cs: Heads-up — SpruceTech renewal at risk. They want to bill to EU entity (SpruceTech Europe) and shorten to 8 months. Procurement says vendor code required for EU billing; customer prefers monthly SEPA. Doc: https://docsend.com/view/sprucetech-renewal-2026

noah_se: Usage profile looks good but streaming tokens still off by default. If they shorten term we should include two enablement labs to lock adoption.

sophie_ae: Customer contact is lena@sprucetech.eu (Finance). She asked whether enablement credit can be applied as a one-off if they sign by EOM.

kevin_proc: For EU billing we need VAT ID + remit address + legal entity. Vendor-code creation ~48h after docs. SEPA monthly acceptable but procurement needs VAT invoice details to map entity.

marta_legal: Short term (8mo) ok but legal wants DPA/DP Addendum attached for EU data handling. Also add clause: "No automatic renewal; billing per agreed entity." Draft ready to attach.

pricing-team: 8-month term -> recommend +11% uplift. If they prepay 6 months upfront -> reduce uplift to +4% and include one enablement session free. Need seat count to finalize.

enablement: we can offer two 90-min labs if contract signed. availability wk of 5/3 or 5/10. Marking tentative slots.

emily_cs: i'll ask Lena to confirm VAT ID and whether they can prepay partially. Sending payment options: SEPA monthly (net30), wire, or prepaid card. Also ask who will sign (legal signoff).

lena@sprucetech.eu: (via DM) We can provide VAT EU987654321, remit: SpruceTech Europe SARL, 7 Rue du Lac, 75008 Paris. Prefer SEPA monthly; worried about BYOK — currently not needed. Signer will be ola@sprucetech.eu (Finance Director).

kevin_proc: Received VAT/remit. We'll create vendor-code once we validate docs. Expect vendor-code in ~36-48h. We'll set payment terms net30 SEPA monthly per request.

marta_legal: attaching DPA link in DocSend now. Also adding clause about EU invoicing and no-auto-renew. Legal clears with DPA attached.

pricing-team: final proposal: list * 1.11 for 8mo monthly SEPA; if 6mo prepay reduce multiplier to 1.04 and include one complimentary enablement lab. Training line item billed if monthly. Await seat counts.

emily_cs: Created DocuSign envelope: SpruceTech Renewal (SOW_v7)  signer: ola@sprucetech.eu. esign-bot will post updates.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: SpruceTech Renewal (SOW_v7). Status: awaiting signature (ola@sprucetech.eu).

emily_cs: TL;DR: EU VAT + remit received, vendor-code queued, pricing uplift for 8mo approved, DPA attached, enablement hold reserved. Target: close by 5/1 if signature returns. :calendar:
